title: cenchrus ciliaris var. leptostachys
intro: Cenchrus ciliaris var. leptostachys, commonly known as the blue grama grass, is a type of grass plant native to North America, known for its attractive blue-green foliage. The health benefits of this plant include its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in wound healing and reducing pain and swelling. The therapeutic actions of Cenchrus ciliaris var. leptostachys include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
